groupings.title: Coding
groupings.description: The development loop — planning, TDD, debugging, review, release — plus language and infrastructure specialists. Partly adapted from Matt Pocock's skills.

groupings.title: Architecture
groupings.description: Design and understand the shape of a system: deep modules, domain language, and guided walkthroughs of unfamiliar code.

groupings.title: Design
groupings.description: Shape, critique, and polish frontend interfaces with strong visual direction and production checks.

groupings.title: Diagrams
groupings.description: Turn systems and data into pictures — draw.io, Mermaid, and diagram-design editorial diagrams.

groupings.title: Presentations
groupings.description: Build slide decks in Marp markdown or PowerPoint.

groupings.title: Observability
groupings.description: Datadog via the pup CLI — auth, logs, APM, monitors, live debugger, CI flakes, and docs.

groupings.title: General
groupings.description: Interviewing, teaching, writing, and note-taking — skills for the work around the code.

groupings.title: Plannotator
groupings.description: Plan and code review in the browser with the plannotator CLI: review diffs, annotate files or URLs, revisit the last reply, mine the plan archive, build goal packages, and render visual explainers.

groupings.title: Ponytail
groupings.description: Build less: choose YAGNI, stdlib, and native features before adding code, then audit what can still be removed.
